items.html: And also from the Botsina deKardinuta, which is the Gevura of Atik, there also came out from it one spark, and this spark was hidden in the womb of Ima; they are in the secret of the Gevurot in the womb of Ima, which are drawn to her from the Gevurot of Atik. And these two discernments in AVI return and clarify the parts needed for ZON, and then one skull came out, etc.
